cause: The sibling rule paired two numeric distribution draws (poisson, zipf) with a text-pool method whose cost the release deliberately cut (text pool became an Arrow take), so the ratio rotted.
context: Operator confirmed 2026-10-20, answer verbatim: "Pair with floats_normal (Recommended)". Block-list item (3): the closure cannot deliver the CI A/B evidence or a green candidate PR while Benchmarks is red.
expected: The sibling rule compares each distribution with a numeric distribution draw (floats_normal, as exponential and lognormal already do) and passes when no method regressed
repro: gh workflow run benchmarks.yml --ref wt/0.8.1/rc-1/wt-rc; the Speed benchmark step exits 1 on compare_siblings
solution: Every distribution method compares with floats_normal, a numeric draw the release does not retune.
symptom: Benchmarks run 39449600526 on head 7647ebf fails: 'over 1.5x sibling: [(poisson, 1000000), (zipf, 1000000)]'. poisson 16.22 ms and zipf 17.81 ms are faster than base, but distincts_prop now builds Arrow text in 10.37 ms (base 89.09 ms), so the 1.5x sibling bound trips without any regression.
title: Benchmark sibling rule pairs poisson and zipf with distincts_prop, a text method
